definitions.full: H7850. shotet שֹׁטֵט noun [masculine] scourge ; — absolute ׳שׁ בְּצִדֵּיבֶם Josh 23:13 (D; national scourge; < read שׁוֺטִים ).
definitions.rootNote: active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from 7752 )
